m: गीता (आ), f. a song, sacred song or poem, religious doctrines declared in metrical form by an inspired sage (cf. Agastya-gītā, Bhagavad-gītā [often called Gītā, Prab. vi, 9/10 &c.], Rāma-gītā, Śiva-gītā)
N. of a metre.
a: गीता — [गै कर्मणि क्त] A name given to certain sacred writings in verse (often in the form of a dialogue) which are devoted to the exposition of particular religious and theosophical doctrines; e. g. शिवगीता, रामगीता, भगवद्गीता. But the name appears to be especially confined tothe last, the Bhagavadgītā; गीतासुगीता कर्तव्या किमन्यैः शास्त्रविस्तरैः . या स्वयं पद्मनाभस्य मुखपद्माद्विनिःसृता .. quoted by Śrīdharasvāmin.

गीतार्थ m. an ascetic who has (sung i.e.) finished his studies, HPariś. viii, 385; xiii, 82.

s: gItAsAraH

puM, (gItAsu sAraH gItAnAM vedAntAdiSAstrARAM vA sAro yatra iti vA । muktyarTaM saMkzepeRa samastayogajYAnAdipratipAdakaSAstrARAM sArArTo gIto yatra iti tAtparyyArTaH .) arjjunaM prati SrIkfzRoktamuktyarTAzwANgAdiyogaH । yaTA, -- SrIBagavAnuvAca । “gItAsAraM pravakzyAmi arjjunAyoditaM purA । azwANgayogaM suktyarTaM sarvvavedAntasAragam ॥ AtmalABaH paro nAnya AtmA dehAdivarjjitaH । rUpAdimAn hi deho'taH karaRatvAdi locanam ॥ karaRatvAnmano'DIno na prARo'cetano yataH । vijYAnarahitaH prARaH suzupte hi pratIyate ॥ nAhamAtmA ca duHKAdisaMsArABisamanvayAt । viDUma iva dIptArccirAditya iva dIptimAn ॥ vEdyuto'gnirivAkASe hftsTo jYeyAtmanAtmani । SrotrAdIni na paSyanti svaM svamAtmAnamAtmanA ॥ sarvvajYaH savvadarSI ca kzetrajYastAni paSyati । svAnAntu manasA raSmIn yadA samyaNniyacCati ॥ tadA prakASate hyAtmA Gawe dIpo jvalanniva । jYAnamutpadyate puMsAM kzayAt pApasya karmmaRaH ॥ yaTAdarSatalapraKye paSyatyAtmAnamAtmani । indriyARIndriyArTAMSca mahABUtAni paYca ca ॥ mano budDimahaNkAramavyaktaM puruzaM taTA । prasaMKyAya parAvAptO vimukto banDanErBavet ॥ indriyagrAmamaKilaM manasyaBiniveSya ca । manaScEvApyahaNkAre pratizWApya ca pARqava ! ॥ ahaNkAraM taTA budDO budDiYca prakftAvapi । prakftiM puruze sTApya puruzaM brahmaRi nyaset ॥ ahaM brahmaparaM jyotiH prasaMKyAya vimucyate । dbidbAdaSeByaH KyAto yaH puruzaH paYcaviMSakaH ॥ vivekAt kevalIBUtaH zaqviMSamanupaSyati । navadbAramidaM gehaM trisTURaM paYcasAkzikam ॥ kzetrajYADizWitaM vidvAn yo veda sa varaH kaviH ॥ jYAnayajYasya sarvvARi kalAM nArhanti zoqaSIm ॥” aSvameDasahasrARi vAjapeyaSatAni ca । iti gAruqe 233 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ SrIBagavAnuvAca । “yamASca niyamAH pArTa ! AsanaM prARasaMyamaH । pratyAhArastaTA DyAnaM DAraRArjjuna ! saptamI ॥ samADirayamazwANgo yoga ukto vimuktaye । karmmaRA manasA vAcA sarvvaBUtezu sarvvadA ॥ akleSajananaM proktaM BUtAnAM yadahiMsanam । ahiMsA paramo Darmmo hyahiMsA paramaM suKam ॥ viDinA yA BavedDiMsA tvahiMsA sA prakIrttitA । yaTA nAgapade'nyAni padAni padagAminAm ॥ sarvvARyevApiDIyante padajAtAni kOYjare । evaM sarvvaM hi hiMsAyAM DarmmArTamapiDIyate ॥ yadBUtahitamatyantaM vacaH satyasya lakzaRam । satyaM brUyAt priyaM brUyAt na brUyAt satyamapriyam ॥ priyaYca nAnftaM brUyAta eza DarmmaH sanAtanaH । yatra dravyApaharaRaM cOryyAdvATa balena vA ॥ steyaM tasyAnAcaraRamasteyaM DarmmasADanam । karmmaRA manasA vAcA sarvvAvasTAsu sarvvadA ॥ sarvvatra mETunatyAgaM brahmacaryyaM pracakzate । dravyARAmapyanAdAnamApatsvapi yaTecCayA ॥ aparigrahamityAhustaM prayatnena varjjayet । dviDA SOcaM mfjjalAByAM bAhyaM BAvAdaTAntaram ॥ yadfcCAlABatastuzwiH santozaH suKalakzaRam । manasaScendriyARAYca EkAgraM paramaM tapaH ॥ SarIraSozaRaM vApi kfcCracAndrAyaRAdiBiH । vedAntaSatarudrIyapraRavAdijapaM buDAH ॥ sattvaSudDikaraM puMsAM svADyAyaM paricakzate । stutismaraRapUjAdivANmanaHkAyakarmmaBiH ॥ suniScalA harO BaktiretadISvaracintanam । AsanaM svastikaM proktaM padmamardDAsanaM taTA ॥ prARaH svadehajo vAyurAyAmastanniroDanam । prARApAnaniroDastu prARAyAma upasTitaH ॥ indriyARAM vicaratAM vizayezu svaBAvataH । niyamaH procyate sadBiH pratyAhArastu pARqava ! ॥ mUrttAmUrttabrahmarUpacintanaM DyAnamucyate । yogAramBe mUrttaharimamUrttamaTa cintayet ॥ nABikande sTitaM nAlaM daSANgulasamAyutam । nAle cAzwadalaM padmaM dvAdaSANgulavistftam ॥ sakarRike keSarAle sUryyasomAgnimaRqalam । agnimaRqalamaDyasTo vAsudevaScaturBujaH ॥ SaNKacakragadApadmayuktaH kOstuBasaMyutaH । vanamAlI kOstuBena yuto'haM brahmamukta om ॥ DAraRetyucyate ceyaM DAryyate yanmanomaye । prANnAByAM hfdaye cAnu tftIyA ca taTorasi ॥ kaRWe muKe nAsikAgre netraBrUmaDyamUrdDasu । kiYcittasmAt parasmiMSca DAraRAdeSakIrttitAH ॥ ahaM brahmetyavasTAnaM samADiraBiDIyate । ekAkAraH samADiH syAddeSalakzaRavarjjitaH ॥” iti gAruqe 234 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ SrIBagavAnuvAca । “brahmagItAM pravakzyAmi yAM jYAtvA mucyate BavAn । ahaM brahmAsmIti vAkyAjjYAnAnmokzo BavennfRAm ॥ vAkyajYAnaM BavejjYAnAdahaMbrahmapadArTayoH । padadvayArTO dviviDO vAcyO lakzyO smftO buDEH ॥ vAcyO daSabalO jYeyO lakzyO SudDO prakIrttitO । prARapiRqAtmakAryyeRa cetanaM SaraRantu yat ॥ taTA vE devaparyyantamahaM Sabdena nocyate । pratyagrUpamadbitIyamahaM Sabdena BaRyate । advayAnandacEtanyaM parokzasahitaM param । prARapiRqAtmakApArTasadvitIyaviBAgakam ॥ tyAgena pratyakcEtanyaBAgo lakzyeta cAhamA । taTA brahmapadenEva prARapiRqAtmakAraRA ॥ vidyAparokzaBAge ca parityAge ca lakzyate । advayAnandacEtanyaBAga evaM vicintayet ॥ ahaMpadena cEtanyapratyagbrahmapadena tu । advayAnandacEtanyaM lakzayitvA sTitasya ca ॥ brahmAhamasmyahaM brahma ahaMbrahmapadArTayoH । ahaM brahmAsmi vAkyAcca AtmaBUtiPalAtmakam ॥ ekatvajYAnaYca BavedvedAntAdguruto Druvam । jYAnAdajYAnatAkAryyanivftterBukta ekataH ॥” iti gAruqe 235 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ SrIBagavAnuvAca । “sammAyibrahmataH KaM syAt KAnmarutvAMstato'nalaH agnerApastataH pfTvI prapaYcIkftaBUtakam ॥ tataH saptadaSaM liNgaM paYca karmmendriyARi ca । vAkpARipAdaM pAyuSca upasTamaTa DIndriyam ॥ SrotraM tvakcakzuzI jihvA GrARaM syAt paYca vAyavaH । prARo'pAnaH samAnaSca vyAnastUdAna eva ca ॥ mano DIrantaHkaraRaM syAnmanaH saMSayAtmakam । budDiniScayarUpA tu etatsUkzmaSarIrakam ॥ hiraRyagarBamAtmIyaM BUtatatkAryyaliNgakam । paYcIkftAni BUtAni apaYcIkftaBUtataH ॥ paYcIkfteByo BUteByo brahmARqaM samajAyata । lokaprasidDaM sTUlAkzaM SarIracaraRAdimat ॥ paYcIkftAni BUtAni tatkAryyaYcAhameva ca । sarvvaM SarIrajAtaYca prARinAM sTUlamIritam ॥ tIrAduparatAtmAnaH SarIraM procyate buDEH । dehadvayABimAnI ca tvamaTo jIva ekataH ॥ sacCabdavAcyaM brahmEva pravizwaM dehayordvayoH । jalArkkavadGawaKavajjIvaH prARAdiDAraRAt ॥ jAgratsvapnasuzuptInAM sAkzI jIvaH sa ca smftaH । jAgratsvapnasuzuptAKyErvyatiriktaSca nirguRaH nirgatAvayavotsargo nityaSudDasvaBAvakaH । paramAtmEva sajjAgratKapnAdO sanniDAnataH antaHkaraRarAgESca antaHkaraRasaMsTitaH । jAgratsvapnasuzuptISca paSyato'vikftaH sadA ॥ PalaM kriyAkArakayorjjAgradAdIn vadAmyaham । indriyEranuvijYAnaM jAgratsTAnamudIritam ॥ jAgratsaMskArasamBUtaH pratyayo vizayAnvitaH । svapnaM prasuptiSaraRopasaMhAro'DipaH sTitaH ॥ brahmakAraRarUpeRa vawasya kaRikAtmanA । kramate kramato jIvo jAgradAdIn sa paSyati ॥ samADyAramBakAle tu pUrvvamevAvaDArayet । mumukzuH paScAt saMjAte antaHkaraRaniScale ॥ vilApayet kzetrajAtaM kzetrajYaM pariSezayet । paYcIkfteByo BUteByaH aRqAdivyatiriktakam ॥ yaTA mfdo Gawo Binno nAsti tatkAryyatastaTA । paYcIkftAni BUtAni apaYcIkftaBUtataH ॥ samazwivyatirekeRa SizwaM sUkzmaSarIrakam । apaYcIkftaBUteByo na liNgaM vyatiriktakam ॥ pfTvIvAri vinA nAsti vAri nAsti ca tejasA । tejaSca vAyunA nAsti vAyuH Kena vinA na hi ॥ sawabrahmaRA ca KaM nAsti SudDabrahma vinA ca sat । SudDaBAvAttaTA jAgratsvapnAdInAmasamBave ॥ jIvatvavarjjitaH pratyagAtmA vE tanurUpakaH । nityaSudDabudDamuktaM satyaM brahmAdvitIyakam ॥ tattvaMpadArTO SizwO tatrAkAro brahmakArakaH । ukAraSca akAraSca makAro'haM dfgadvayaH ॥ brahmAhamasmyahaM brahma jYAnamajYAnamarddanam । ayamAtmA brahmajyotirvijYAnAnandarUpakam ॥ satyajYAnamanantaH sa tattvamasi SrutIritam । ahaM brahmAsmi brahmAhaM sarvvaprARizu sarvvagam ॥ yo'sAvAdityapuruzaH so'sAvahamanAdimat । gItAsAro'rjjunAyokto yena brahmaRi vE layaH ॥” ityAdimahApurARe gAruqe gItAsAre 236 aDyAyaH ॥

s: gItaM

klI, (gIyate iti । gE gAne + BAve ktaH .) gAnam । ityamaraH । 1 । 6 । 25 ॥ tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, “DAtumAtusamAyuktaM gItamityucyate buDEH । tatra nAdAtmako DAturmAturakzarasaYcayaH ॥” * ॥ taddviviDaM yaTA, -- “gItaYca dviviDaM proktaM yantragAtraviBAgataH । yantraM syAdveRuvIRAdi gAtrantu muKajaM matam ॥” api ca । “nibadDamanibadDaYca gItaM dviviDamucyate । anibadDaM BavedgItaM varRAdiniyamaM vinA ॥ yadbA gamakaDAtujYEranibadDaM vinA kftam । nibadDaYca BavedgItaM tAlamAnarasAYcitam ॥ Cando gamakaDAtujYErvarRAdiniyamEH kftam ॥ fgBiH pAWyamaBUdgItaM sAmaByaH samapadyata । yajurByo'BinayA jAtA rasAScATarvvaRaH smftAH ॥” aTa saMgItalakzaRam । “tAlavAdyAnugaM gItaM nawIBiryatra gIyate । nftyasyAnugataM raNge tat saNgItakamucyate ॥” * ॥ aTa gItapraSaMsA । “saNgItakena ramyeRa suKaM yasya na cetasi । manuzyavfzaBo loke viDinEva sa vaYcitaH ॥ saMsAraduHKadagDAnAmuttamAnAmanugrahAt । praBuRA SaNkareRAtra gItavAdyaM prakASitam ॥ gItaM vAdyaM taTA nftyaM tOryyatrikamidaM matam । tUryyaSabdo mfdaNge syAt muraje'pi ca dfSyate ॥ gItajYo yadi gItena nApnoti paramaM padam । rudrasyAnucaro BUtvA tenEva saha modate ॥ gItena hariRA raNgaM prApnuvantyapi pakziRaH । vanAdAyAnti PaRinaH SiSavo na rudanti ca ॥ kfticamatkftaye kimataH paraM PaRivaro'Svataro vata paYcamaH । api mftAM yadavApa madAlasAM maDuragItavaSIkftaSaNkaraH ॥ paramAnandavivardDanamaBimataPalaM vaSIkaraRam । sakalajanacittaharaRaM vimuktibIjaM paraM gItam ॥ gItaM pInapayoDarA samadanA nArI vicitrA kaTA ramyaM harmmyatalaM suDAMSukiraRaproddIpitA yAminI । cittajYAH suhfdaH sutAH sumanaso BaktAH punaH sevakAH SudDaM gItaPalaM kavitvamatulaM saMsArasArA matAH ॥” “SudDaSAlagasaNkIrRaBedAdgItaM triDA matam .” SudDasUtraM viMSatiryaTA, -- “elA so'dyaBavA sapAQakaraRaM tatpaYcatAleSvaraH kErAtasmaracakrapAlavijayA gadyaM triBaNgistaTA । QeNkIvarRasaraH puwO dvipadikA muktAvalI mAhakA lambo daRqakavarttanIti kaTitAH SudDAstu te viMSatiH ॥” elAdInAmetezAM viMSatisaMKyakAnAM prabanDagItA । nAmaNgAni zaw Bavanti । taTA ca । “padaM tAno virUdaSca tAlaH pAQaH svarastaTA । elAdInAM zaqaNgAni kaTitAni viriYcinA ॥ pOnaruktyaM na deSIye gIte dozo'BijAyate । SIGroccAreRa varRAnAM taTA cEva prasAraRe ॥ liNgAnyatve visanDO ca saMyuktAkzaramokzaRe । parivartte'kzarARAYca hrasvadIrGavyatikrame ॥” * ॥ aTa SAlagasUtram । “Druvako maRqakaScEva pratimaRqo nisArukaH । vAsakaH pratilABaSca taTAnyA cEkatAlikA ॥ yatiSca JumariSceti SAlagaM sUtramIritam ॥” * ॥ aTa saNkIrRasUtram । cEtromaNgatmakastaTA na gaRikA carccAtinAwonnavI dohA syAdbahulastaTA gurubalo gItA ca govistaTA । m: गीत mfn. (√ गै) sung, chanted, praised in songs, Mn. ix, 42; MBh. &c.
गीत n. singing, song, VS. xxx; TBr. iii; ŚBr. iii, vi; Āp. &c.
N. of four hymns addressed to Kṛṣṇa
a: गीत — p. p. [गै-क्त] 1 Sung, chanted (lit.); आर्ये साधु गीतं Ś. 1; चारणद्वंद्वगीतः शब्दः Ś. 2. 14. --2 Declared, told, said; गीतश्चायमर्थोंऽगिरसा Māl. 2; (see under गै also). --तं Singing, a song; तवास्मि गीतरागेण हारिणा प्रसभं हृतः Ś. 1. 5; गीतमुत्सादकारि मृगाणां K. 32. --Comp. --अयनं a means or instrument of singing, i. e. a lute, flute &c. --क्रमः the arrangement of a song. --ज्ञ a. versed in the art of singing. --प्रिय a. fond of song or music. --(यः) an epithet of Śiva. --(या) N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda. --मोदिन् m. a Kinnara. --शास्त्रं the science of music.

k.v: वीणायाः क्वणिते प्रादेः प्रक्वाणप्रक्वणादयः। कोलाहलः कलकलस्तिरश्चां वाशितं रुतम्.। स्त्री प्रतिश्रुत्प्रतिध्वाने गीतं गानमिमे समे॥

m: गीत—शास्त्र n. the science of song, W.
गीत—बन्धन n. an epic poem to be sung, R. vii, 71, 21.
गीत—गङ्गा-धर n. ‘the ocean of songs’, N. of a poem by Kalyāṇa.
गीत—गिरीश n. N. of a poem by Rāma.

v: pu॰ gItogovindo'tra । jayadevakfte SrIkfzRacaritaKyApake dvAdaSasargAtmake granTaBede । “yacCfNgAra vivekatattvamapi satkAvyezu lIlAyitam tatsarvaM jayadevapaRqitakaveH kfzREkatAnAtmanaH । sAnandAH pariSoDayantu suDiyaH SrIgItagovinditaH” gItago॰ ।
m: गीत—गोविन्द n. ‘Govinda (i.e. Kṛṣṇa) celebrated in song’, N. of a lyrical drama by Jayadeva (probably written in the beginning of the twelfth century; it is a mystical erotic poem describing the loves of Kṛṣṇa and the Gopīs, especially of Kṛṣṇa and Rādhā, who is supposed to typify the human soul).
गीत—ज्ञ mfn. versed in the art of singing, acquainted with songs, Yājñ. iii, 116.
a metre of 4 × 20 syllables
a stanza composed in the Gīti metre, Kathās. cxvii, 109 (with reference to, 65 f.) (cf. दश-गीतिका.)
गीतक n. a song, hymn, Yājñ. iii, 113; BhP. viii; VP. (Sāh. i, 2/3, 14), Kathās.
